meta.note: Synthetic Track-7 dataset (see README sheet). Injections are the scenario script derived from observed_signal; detection rules consume telemetry only, events stay eval gold.

readme.value: AI Maps Track 7: AI Group Drive – Safe Collaborative Navigation Assistant
Synthetic group trips, trip members, route waypoints, simulated GPS traces, trip events, regroup POIs, voice commands, mock APIs, public evaluation and hidden judge evaluation.
This dataset is synthetic and does not contain real users, real routes, real GPS traces or internal Tasco/VETC data.
Participants can simulate a group trip, detect route deviation/group split/lost member/delay, recommend safe regroup points, generate voice-style alerts, and create AI trip summaries.
Real GPS, production routing and speech-to-text are not required. Simulated GPS traces, mock route geometry, predefined voice commands and mock APIs are acceptable.
